recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-12943 unless a future Patient Care decision changes Condition staging semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-12943 was a Published Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking that Condition.stage have cardinality 0..* and that a new 0..1 Condition.stage.type CodeableConcept be added with an example SNOMED binding covering pathological staging, clinical staging, and descendants of 254291000 Staging and scales.
initial_application: The issue was applied in two 2017 source commits: 8da21fd1 changed the then-authoritative Condition spreadsheet so Condition.stage became 0..* and introduced the ConditionStageType binding, and 6d557e5b finished exposing Condition.stage.type, added its RIM mapping, created valueset-condition-stage-type.xml, and updated a Condition example. Later source refactors carried those changes into source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml.
additional_context: Condition is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, so source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml is in the current build. Later Condition.stage Jira work found during the neighborhood search concerned trial-use/normative designation or summary wording, not reversal of FHIR-12943.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current source has Condition.stage min 0/max *, Condition.stage.type min 0/max 1, an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/condition-stage-type, and the value set includes SNOMED 261023001, 260998006, and an is-a 254291000 filter.
